dataList.name: Limbus Company Specialized Custom Prosthetic Prototype mk5 - Dokkaebi Arms
dataList.desc:
Bắt Đầu Ải: Nhận [AengduNewArm]

If there is an ally at less than 50% HP on the field excluding this unit, nhận 1 [SupportProtect] (mỗi lượt một lần)

dataList.name: Demonfire Spinecleaver
dataList.desc:
Skill End: Nhận 1 [WindBlade] for every 3 [Breath] (max 5, 2 lần mỗi lượt)

On Base Attack Skill End: At 15+ [WindBlade], activate "Even the Balance - Lucent Rippling Flame" on the enemy (mỗi lượt một lần)

On Defense Skill Clash Lose, if this unit has 3+ [Agility], this unit cannot be Staggered from taking damage until Defense Skill End, and activate "To Claim Their Bones" against the enemy after being hit (2 lần mỗi lượt, excluding forced Staggers)
dataList.summary: Activate additional Skill when conditions are met

dataList.name: Swiftblade
dataList.desc: On Crit, nhận 1 [Agility] vào lượt kế (3 lần mỗi Kỹ Năng, 2 lần mỗi lượt)

dataList.name: To Where I Must Return
dataList.desc:
When 3 or more other Blade Lineage allies are defeated:
- When gaining Lượng [Breath]/Count using this unit's own Skills and Coin effects: Nhận 1 more of each
- When 5 or more other Blade Lineage allies are defeated, nhận 2 more of each instead
- Combat Start: Apply [SwordPlayOfTheHomeland] on self

dataList.name: Fugitive
dataList.desc: Upon entering the Encounter for the first time, nhận [BrandedKimSatgat]

dataList.name: Bearing of a Salsu
dataList.desc:
At 1 Tầng [Breath], lose 10 HP instead of losing Tầng [Breath] (this effect cannot Stagger this unit and does not drop this unit's HP below 1)

Deal +(missing HP percentage on self / 2) damage on Critical Hit using Kỹ Năng Cơ Bản (tối đa 50%)

dataList.name: Swordplay of the Homeland
dataList.desc:
Combat Start: If Pride Reson. was activated,
- Nhận (Pride Reson. x 2) [Breath] (tối đa 8)
- Gán 1 [SlashResultUp] và 1 [CriticalDamageUp] on all Sinners and Assist Units excluding this unit (for Blade Lineage targets, double this effect)

Cuối Lượt: Nhận ([Breath] on self / 4) [Agility] vào lượt kế (max 6, rounded down)

dataList.name: Sư Phụ Gia Tộc Kiếm Sư
dataList.desc:
When gaining Lượng [Breath]/Count using this unit's own Skills and Coin effects: Gán 1 Lượng [Breath] và 1 Tầng [Breath] on the Sinner and 2 Assist Units that do not have [Breath] or have the lowest Lượng [Breath] (excluding this unit)
- For Blade Lineage allies, gán 3 Lượng [Breath] và +2 Tầng [Breath] instead

When a Blade Lineage Sinner or Assist Unit is defeated, this unit loses 10 SP

dataList.name: Yield My Flesh to Claim Their Bones
dataList.desc:
In this Encounter, when this unit takes damage that brings its HP down to 0, nullify that damage; then, this unit's HP cannot drop below 1 for the turn (once per Encounter)

Cuối Lượt: At 30+ Lượng [Breath], fix this unit's Speed to 20 vào lượt kế and equip "Yield My Flesh" on the leftmost Skill Slot
- If "Yield My Flesh" becomes inaccessible due to Skill effect, this effect does not activate

dataList.name: Fate Lost
dataList.desc: Lose this Encounter if this unit is killed
